description: This file defines the CanvasManager class, which manages canvas windows, sessions, and interactions within a macOS application. It handles showing, hiding, and navigating canvases, manages observers for gateway updates, and handles auto-navigation to specific URLs based on gateway snapshots. It also provides debug status updates and URL resolution functionalities.

classes.name: CanvasManager
classes.description: A singleton class responsible for managing canvas windows, sessions, and auto-navigation logic within a macOS application.

methods.name: show
methods.description: Displays a canvas session with a given session key, optional path, and placement. Returns the directory path of the canvas.

methods.name: showDetailed
methods.description: Provides detailed control over presenting a canvas session, including targeting a specific path and placement. Returns a CanvasShowResult object detailing the show status.

methods.name: hide
methods.description: Hides the canvas session associated with the provided session key.

methods.name: eval
methods.description: Evaluates JavaScript code in the context of the current canvas session, returning the result as a string.

methods.name: snapshot
methods.description: Takes a snapshot of the current canvas session and saves it to the specified output path.
